first_48h_maintainer_outcome.body:
Hi @eitan-shalev , I'd be interested in working on this issue.
I can investigate how the current Dag search state and URL parameters are handled, then add persistence for the `match-anywhere` option while keeping the existing search behavior unchanged. I'll also add/update the relevant tests.

If it's still available, I'd be happy to work on it. Thanks!
Not really in scope for this issue, but does it even make sense to have an option to not search everywhere? I can't really think of a use-case where someone would want that behavior.
